about: The unchanged jira.js 5.4.0 Version3Client, constructed as Twin's on-call agent (cookbook/on-call-agent/agent.mjs) constructs it: the site's URL, https://acme.atlassian.net, with Basic authentication by the account's email and the API token the World's credential door issues as JIRA_API_TOKEN. It reads the token's account (myself.getCurrentUser), makes the OPS project that account leads, files the agent's Task with its ADF description and High priority through the agent's own createIssue call, opens the ticket and checks every field it filed, and draws the 404 HttpException of a key no issue carries. Readback reads the ticket and the project again without writing.
